     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedOver
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleModelComparison
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Base change of the final finite-stage Picard atlas
    11	
    12	The glue package extends the finite-presentation models from `M` to a final finite
    13	subextension `N`.  Extending once more to the separably closed field cancels the tower
    14	`M -> N -> k`.  The resulting component equivalences recover the exact Picard atlas
    15	rings and intertwine every restriction and transition map.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory TensorProduct
    23	open scoped TensorProduct
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    26	
    27	noncomputable section
    28	
    29	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    30	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    31	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [IsSepClosed k]
    32	
    33	/-- A finite-presentation model ring after extension to the final finite subextension. -/
    34	noncomputable abbrev Pic0FiniteStageFinalModelRing
    35	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    36	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    37	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    38	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    39	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    40	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext M.1 k)
    41	    (j : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) : Type u :=
    42	  N.1 ⊗[M.1] Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M j
    43	
    44	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
    45	-- The comparison cancels two nested finite-subextension scalar towers.
    46	set_option maxHeartbeats 6400000 in
    47	/-- Scalar extension of a final finite-stage model ring recovers its exact atlas ring. -/
    48	noncomputable def pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv
    49	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    50	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    51	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    52	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    53	    (e : forall j,
    54	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    55	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    56	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    57	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext M.1 k)
    58	    (j : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C) :
    59	    k ⊗[N.1] Pic0FiniteStageFinalModelRing C L n m relation M N j ≃ₐ[k]
    60	      Pic0FiniteStageRing C j :=
    61	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
    62	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M j)).trans
    63	      (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M j)
    64	
    65	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 400000 in
    66	-- Naturality elaborates the cancellation and model-comparison squares together.
    67	set_option maxHeartbeats 12800000 in
    68	/-- The final component comparisons intertwine every scalar-extended finite-stage map
    69	with its exact restriction or transition map. -/
    70	theorem pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv_naturality
    71	    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F k]
    72	    (L : DatG0.FinSubext F k)
    73	    (n m : Pic0FiniteStageRingIndex C -> Nat)
    74	    (relation : forall j, Fin (m j) -> MvPolynomial (Fin (n j)) L.1)
    75	    (e : forall j,
    76	      k ⊗[L.1] DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1 (n j) (m j) (relation j) ≃ₐ[k]
    77	        Pic0FiniteStageRing C j)
    78	    (M : DatG0.FinSubext L.1 k)
    79	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic M.1 k]
    80	    (mapM : forall q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C,
    81	      Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    82	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q) →ₐ[M.1]
    83	        Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
    84	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    85	    (hmapM : forall q,
    86	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    87	          (AlgHom.id L.1
    88	            (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    89	              (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    90	              (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))
    91	              (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))))).comp
    92	          ((mapM q).restrictScalars L.1) =
    93	        ((pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C L n m relation e q).restrictScalars
    94	          L.1).comp
    95	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val
    96	            (AlgHom.id L.1
    97	              (DatG0.FiniteRelationAlgebra L.1
    98	                (n (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
    99	                (m (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))
   100	                (relation (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))))))
   101	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext M.1 k)
   102	    (q : Pic0FiniteStageMapIndex C) :
   103	    (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M N
   104	        (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).toAlgHom.comp
   105	        (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   106	          (R := N.1) (K := k)
   107	          (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   108	            (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))) =
   109	      (pic0FiniteStageMap C q).comp
   110	        (pic0FiniteStageFinalBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M N
   111	          (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)).toAlgHom := by
   112	  have hval : N.1.val = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom M.1 N.1 k := by
   113	    ext x
   114	    rfl
   115	  have htower :=
   116	    scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_tower_finSubext (K := k) N (mapM q)
   117	  rw [hval] at htower
   118	  have hcancel := AlgebraicJacobian.cancelBaseChange_naturality
   119	    (F := M.1) (L := N.1) (K := k)
   120	    (phiL := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   121	      (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))
   122	    (phiK := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   123	      (R := M.1) (K := k) (mapM q))
   124	    htower
   125	  have hmodel := pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv_naturality
   126	    C L n m relation e M mapM hmapM q
   127	  let eTarget := (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M
   128	    (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q)).toAlgHom
   129	  let eSource := (pic0FiniteStageModelBaseChangeEquiv C L n m relation e M
   130	    (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q)).toAlgHom
   131	  let cTarget := (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
   132	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   133	      (Pic0FiniteStageMapTarget C q))).toAlgHom
   134	  let cSource := (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange M.1 N.1 k k
   135	    (Pic0FiniteStageModelRing C L n m relation M
   136	      (Pic0FiniteStageMapSource C q))).toAlgHom
   137	  let fN := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   138	    (R := N.1) (K := k)
   139	    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   140	      (R := M.1) (K := N.1) (mapM q))
   141	  let fK := AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom
   142	    (R := M.1) (K := k) (mapM q)
   143	  let g := pic0FiniteStageMap C q
   144	  change cTarget.comp fN = fK.comp cSource at hcancel
   145	  change eTarget.comp fK = g.comp eSource at hmodel
   146	  change (eTarget.comp cTarget).comp fN = g.comp (eSource.comp cSource)
   147	  calc
   148	    _ = eTarget.comp (cTarget.comp fN) := AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _
   149	    _ = eTarget.comp (fK.comp cSource) :=
   150	      congrArg (fun f => eTarget.comp f) hcancel
   151	    _ = (eTarget.comp fK).comp cSource := (AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm
   152	    _ = (g.comp eSource).comp cSource :=
   153	      congrArg (fun f => f.comp cSource) hmodel
   154	    _ = g.comp (eSource.comp cSource) := AlgHom.comp_assoc _ _ _
   155	
   156	end
   157	
   158	end AlgebraicGeometry

    13	/-!
    14	# Gluing Schemes
    15	
    16	Given a family of gluing data of schemes, we may glue them together.
    17	Also see the section about "locally directed" gluing,
    18	which is a special case where the conditions are easier to check.
    19	
    20	## Main definitions
    21	
    22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData`: A structure containing the family of gluing data.
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.glued`: The glued scheme.
    24	    This is defined as the multicoequalizer of `∐ V i j ⇉ ∐ U i`, so that the general colimit API
    25	    can be used.
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι`: The immersion `ι i : U i ⟶ glued` for each `i : J`.
    27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isoCarrier`: The isomorphism between the underlying space
    28	  of the glued scheme and the gluing of the underlying topological spaces.
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.gluedCover`: The glue data associated with an open cover.
    30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.fromGlued`: The canonical morphism
    31	  `𝒰.gluedCover.glued ⟶ X`. This has an `is_iso` instance.
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.OpenCover.glueMorphisms`: We may glue a family of compatible
    33	  morphisms defined on an open cover of a scheme.
    34	
    35	## Main results
    36	
    37	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_isOpenImmersion`: The map `ι i : U i ⟶ glued`
    38	  is an open immersion for each `i : J`.
    39	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_jointly_surjective` : The underlying maps of
    40	  `ι i : U i ⟶ glued` are jointly surjective.
    41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.vPullbackConeIsLimit` : `V i j` is the pullback
    42	  (intersection) of `U i` and `U j` over the glued space.
    43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.ι_eq_iff` : `ι i x = ι j y` if and only if they coincide
    44	  when restricted to `V i i`.
    45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GlueData.isOpen_iff` : A subset of the glued scheme is open iff
    46	  all its preimages in `U i` are open.
    47	
    48	## Implementation details
    49	
    50	All the hard work is done in `Mathlib/Geometry/RingedSpace/PresheafedSpace/Gluing.lean` where we
    51	glue presheafed spaces, sheafed spaces, and locally ringed spaces.
    52	
    53	-/

    72	/-- A family of gluing data consists of
    73	1. An index type `J`
    74	2. A scheme `U i` for each `i : J`.
    75	3. A scheme `V i j` for each `i j : J`.
    76	  (Note that this is `J × J → Scheme` rather than `J → J → Scheme` to connect to the
    77	  limits library easier.)
    78	4. An open immersion `f i j : V i j ⟶ U i` for each `i j : ι`.
    79	5. A transition map `t i j : V i j ⟶ V j i` for each `i j : ι`.
    80	
    81	such that
    82	6. `f i i` is an isomorphism.
    83	7. `t i i` is the identity.
    84	8. `V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V i j ⟶ V j i` factors through `V j k ×[U j] V j i ⟶ V j i` via some
    85	    `t' : V i j ×[U i] V i k ⟶ V j k ×[U j] V j i`.
    86	9. `t' i j k ≫ t' j k i ≫ t' k i j = 𝟙 _`.
    87	
    88	We can then glue the schemes `U i` together by identifying `V i j` with `V j i`, such
    89	that the `U i`'s are open subschemes of the glued space.

     9	/-!
    10	# Gluing affine schemes from ring maps
    11	
    12	This file packages affine ring data into `Scheme.GlueData`.  The overlap restriction
    13	maps are the algebra maps `A i -> B i j`.  Thus an application with specified restriction
    14	maps should install the corresponding `Algebra (A i) (B i j)` structures (for example via
    15	`r.toRingHom.toAlgebra`) before invoking the constructor.
    16	
    17	The only non-formal coherence assumptions are ring identities:
    18	
    19	* each transition `tau i j : B j i -> B i j` is the identity on the diagonal;
    20	* the triple transition `theta i j k` sends the right tensor inclusion to the left
    21	  inclusion followed by `tau i j`;
    22	* the three cyclic triple transitions compose to the identity.
    23	
    24	The constructor conjugates `Spec.map theta` by Mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso`.  The face and
    25	cocycle fields of `Scheme.GlueData` are then discharged from the displayed ring identities.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits AlgebraicGeometry
    33	open scoped TensorProduct
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicJacobian
    36	
    37	noncomputable section
    38	
    39	variable {R J : Type u} [CommRing R]
    40	variable (A : J → Type u) (B : J → J → Type u)
    41	variable [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i j, CommRing (B i j)]
    42	variable [∀ i, Algebra R (A i)] [∀ i j, Algebra R (B i j)]
    43	variable [∀ i j, Algebra (A i) (B i j)]
    44	variable [∀ i j, IsScalarTower R (A i) (B i j)]
    45	
    46	/-- The coordinate ring of the pullback of the two overlaps based at chart `i`. -/
    47	abbrev AffineTripleTensor (i j k : J) : Type u :=
    48	  B i j ⊗[A i] B i k
    49	
    50	/-- The left overlap inclusion into an affine triple tensor, viewed over `R`. -/
    51	def affineTensorIncludeLeft (i j k : J) :
    52	    B i j →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k :=
    53	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
    54	    B i j →ₐ[A i] B i j ⊗[A i] B i k).restrictScalars R
    55	
    56	/-- The right overlap inclusion into an affine triple tensor, viewed over `R`. -/
    57	def affineTensorIncludeRight (i j k : J) :
    58	    B i k →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k :=
    59	  (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    60	    B i k →ₐ[A i] B i j ⊗[A i] B i k).restrictScalars R
    61	
    62	/-- The affine overlap inclusion induced contravariantly by `A i -> B i j`. -/
    63	abbrev affineRestriction (i j : J) :
    64	    Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i j)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (A i)) :=
    65	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A i) (B i j)))
    66	
    67	/-- The affine transition induced contravariantly by `tau i j : B j i -> B i j`. -/
    68	abbrev affineTransition (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j) (i j : J) :
    69	    Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i j)) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (B j i)) :=
    70	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i j).toRingHom)
    71	
    72	/-- The canonical affine chart for a triple pullback. -/
    73	abbrev affineTriplePullbackIso (i j k : J) :
    74	    pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≅
    75	      Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) :=
    76	  pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)
    77	
    78	/-- A ring map between the rotated triple tensor rings, conjugated into a morphism between
    79	the actual scheme pullbacks used by `Scheme.GlueData`. -/
    80	def affineTripleTransition
    81	    (theta : ∀ i j k,
    82	      AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
    83	    (i j k : J) :
    84	    pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ⟶
    85	      pullback (affineRestriction A B j k) (affineRestriction A B j i) :=
    86	  (affineTriplePullbackIso A B i j k).hom ≫
    87	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta i j k).toRingHom) ≫
    88	      (affineTriplePullbackIso A B j k i).inv
    89	
    90	variable (tau : ∀ i j, B j i →ₐ[R] B i j)
    91	variable (theta : ∀ i j k,
    92	  AffineTripleTensor A B j k i →ₐ[R] AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)
    93	
    94	/-- The right-face ring identity implies the factorization field of `Scheme.GlueData`. -/
    95	@[reassoc]
    96	theorem affineTripleTransition_fac
    97	    (hfac : ∀ i j k,
    98	      (theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i) =
    99	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j))
   100	    (i j k : J) :
   101	    affineTripleTransition A B theta i j k ≫
   102	        pullback.snd (affineRestriction A B j k) (affineRestriction A B j i) =
   103	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   104	        affineTransition B tau i j := by
   105	  have hfac' :
   106	      CommRingCat.ofHom
   107	          (((theta i j k).comp (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i)).toRingHom) =
   108	        CommRingCat.ofHom
   109	          (((affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)).toRingHom) :=
   110	    congrArg (fun f => CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) (hfac i j k)
   111	  simp only [affineTripleTransition, Category.assoc]
   112	  rw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd]
   113	  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   114	  change (pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)).hom ≫
   115	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   116	        (((theta i j k).comp
   117	          (affineTensorIncludeRight A B j k i)).toRingHom)) =
   118	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   119	        affineTransition B tau i j
   120	  rw [hfac']
   121	  rw [show
   122	      ((affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).comp (tau i j)).toRingHom =
   123	        (affineTensorIncludeLeft A B i j k).toRingHom.comp
   124	          (tau i j).toRingHom by rfl]
   125	  rw [CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, Spec.map_comp]
   126	  change (pullbackSpecIso (A i) (B i j) (B i k)).hom ≫
   127	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   128	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom :
   129	          B i j →+* AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)) ≫
   130	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tau i j).toRingHom) =
   131	      pullback.fst (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k) ≫
   132	        affineTransition B tau i j
   133	  rw [← Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst]
   134	
   135	/-- A cyclic identity of triple-tensor ring maps implies the scheme-level cocycle. -/
   136	theorem affineTripleTransition_cocycle
   137	    (hcycle : ∀ i j k,
   138	      (theta i j k).comp ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j)) =
   139	        AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))
   140	    (i j k : J) :
   141	    affineTripleTransition A B theta i j k ≫
   142	        affineTripleTransition A B theta j k i ≫
   143	          affineTripleTransition A B theta k i j =
   144	      𝟙 (pullback (affineRestriction A B i j) (affineRestriction A B i k)) := by
   145	  have hmap :
   146	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta i j k).toRingHom) ≫
   147	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta j k i).toRingHom) ≫
   148	            Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (theta k i j).toRingHom) =
   149	        𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k))) := by
   150	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   151	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
   152	    have hcycle' :
   153	        CommRingCat.ofHom
   154	            (((theta i j k).comp
   155	              ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j))).toRingHom) =
   156	          CommRingCat.ofHom
   157	            ((AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)).toRingHom) :=
   158	      congrArg (fun f => CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) (hcycle i j k)
   159	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   160	      (((theta i j k).comp
   161	        ((theta j k i).comp (theta k i j))).toRingHom)) =
   162	      𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)))
   163	    rw [hcycle']
   164	    rw [show (AlgHom.id R (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k)).toRingHom =
   165	      RingHom.id (AffineTripleTensor A B i j k) by rfl]

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite tensor-stage descent of a pinned cocycle datum
    12	
    13	A `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` over `K ⊗[F] B` descends to a datum over
    14	`M ⊗[F] B` for a finite intermediate field `M/F`.  The datum is first descended to a
    15	finitely generated coefficient subalgebra, then that subalgebra is factored through one
    16	finite tensor stage.  The tower law for datum base change transports the certificate strictly.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory
    24	
    25	open scoped TensorProduct
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	noncomputable section

    31	/-- Spread a pinned cocycle datum over `K ⊗[F] B` to one finite tensor stage over `F`. -/
    32	theorem BasicOpenCocycleDatum.exists_finSubext_tensorStage
    33	    {F K B : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    34	    [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    35	    {C : Over (Spec (.of F))} {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 F} [IsAffineHom pi]
    36	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (K ⊗[F] B) pi) :
    37	    ∃ M : DatG0.FinSubext F K,
    38	      letI : Algebra F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    39	      let ι : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    40	        Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    41	      letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) := ι.toAlgebra
    42	      letI : IsScalarTower F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    43	        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)
    44	          inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    45	          (fun x => (ι.commutes x).symm)
    46	      ∃ D_M : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C (M.1 ⊗[F] B) pi,
    47	        D_M.baseChange (K ⊗[F] B) = D := by
    48	  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀, D₀, hD₀⟩ := D.exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq
    49	  obtain ⟨M, f, hfactor⟩ :=
    50	    DatG0.exists_finSubext_fg_subalgebra_tensorProduct_factor A₀ hA₀
    51	  letI : Algebra F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.instAlgebra
    52	  let ι : M.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B :=
    53	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map M.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)
    54	  letI : Algebra A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) :=
    55	    f.toRingHom.toAlgebra' (by
    56	      intro c x
    57	      exact mul_comm (f.toRingHom c) x)
    58	  letI : IsScalarTower F A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) :=
    59	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (f.commutes x).symm
    60	  letI : Algebra (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    61	    ι.toRingHom.toAlgebra' (by
    62	      intro c x
    63	      exact mul_comm (ι.toRingHom c) x)
    64	  letI : IsScalarTower F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    65	    @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq F (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)
    66	      inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    67	      (fun x => (ι.commutes x).symm)
    68	  letI : IsScalarTower A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B) :=
    69	    @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq A₀ (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)
    70	      inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
    71	      (fun a => by
    72	        change a.1 = ι (f a)
    73	        exact congrArg (fun g : A₀ →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] B => g a) hfactor.symm)
    74	  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
    75	  dsimp only
    76	  exact ⟨D₀.baseChange (M.1 ⊗[F] B),
    77	    (D₀.baseChange_baseChange C (A₀ : Type u) (M.1 ⊗[F] B) (K ⊗[F] B)).trans hD₀⟩
